newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Nine miners killed in explosion at Russian pit.
newsitem.headline: Nine miners killed in explosion at Russian pit.

text.p: Nine miners were killed and four seriously injured on Sunday in an explosion at a coalmine in Russia's Urals region, the emergencies ministry said.

A ministry spokesman said by telephone from the regional centre Chelyabinsk that a methane gas explosion had caused the tragedy at the Baturinskaya pit 60 km (38 miles) south of Chelyabinsk, not far from Russia's border with Kazakhstan.
Nine dead miners had been brought to the surface after the blast at 2.30 a.m. Moscow time (2330 GMT). Four miners were in intensive care while two escaped unhurt.
"There were all in all 15 miners in the pit and we know that there is no one left inside," the spokesman said.
